The `minds_env` log-line stamping this branch introduced shipped to main early (carried verbatim by the `mngr/report-connector-errors` convergence), so this branch's remaining change here is a rename: the shared `MINDS_ENV_NAME` reader is now `deployed_minds_env_name()` (was `minds_env_name_for_log_lines`), reflecting that it also feeds non-logging env scoping -- the connector's slice-box reconcile now uses it instead of its own duplicate reader.
